description:
Five sites in src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs clone a DispatchNode (a RegionPredicate and two edges with evidence for Test nodes) before matching on it: :447, :2002, :3020, :3076, :3591, all of the form plan.graph.node(node_id).cloned(). In each the plan arrives as a reference parameter or through the program reference, not through &mut self.
Also unforced in the same file: :2295 entry.origin.clone() followed by tys.to_vec() / reprs.to_vec(); :2818 (entry.captures.clone(), entry.physical_captures.clone()); :3203 lanes.clone(). And src/compiler2/native_codegen/prim.rs:1808 decl.params.clone().
Out of scope: the ShapeDescr / CallableDescr clones through self.world (:764, :1378, :2949, :4149, :4416, :4433, :4552); they need a different shape and their own ticket if this one goes cleanly.
Heat: every node of every dispatch tree lowered, per executable.

Method: .agent/strategies/ownership-shape.md. Change the signature and let cargo check enumerate dependents; resolve interleavings by compute-then-commit or a split borrow; stop and report if an Rc is the only move.
Signal: pure refactor. Full gate green; no golden, census or pin moves. Report the clone/to_vec count of each touched file before and after.
Sites were read at develop 8bf8775ae and not compiled; confirm each with cargo check before relying on it.
title: The native lowerer matches a dispatch node where it lives
